title: Florida appeals court orders fresh review after wife loses alimony and all parenting time following pay cut
summary_full: In an emerging divorce case from Florida, the Fourth District Court has called for a deeper examination of the rulings made by the Broward County trial court involving Rebecca Zalkin and Jeffrey Zalkin. The initial decision denied alimony and granted sole parental responsibility to the husband without sufficient reasoning. The appellate court highlighted the necessity for validated income data and adherence to legal protocol.
